### 1. User expression and simulator role
The customer (Wendeline Sorbara) states: power at the house was shut off yesterday (Monday), she wants it reconnected today, will pay by debit card; she identifies by phone 6164158823, SSN last-4 1764 (ZIP 49423 / email if more needed). She does not know the amount and asks the agent to work out "exactly what is needed"; she agrees if "something has to be put on the account or worked out before the amount can be settled"; she pays exactly the amount handed over via the card tool and reads back the confirmation; no preference on restoration method; accepts the reconnection charge. Target object = her disconnected agreement; action boundary = reconnect today on payment; authorisation = she runs the card payment herself (user-owned tool). The simulator is passive/conditional; it executes the user tool only when handed over.

### 4. Scored parameters (formula, inputs, intermediates, tier and the returns that put the customer there)

**(a) Late payment charge on bill 99539ce4** (posting 2026-09-29).
- Due 2026-09-22 + RS grace 5 days (doc_service_bill_due_date_and_late_payment_schedule_values: RS grace 5) → grace days 9/23–9/27, charge postable from 9/28. Exemptions: income_qualified_until 2025-06-30 < due date (no exemption); no meter test (`find_meter_tests`: none). Status disconnected is a permitted status ("active, notice pending or disconnected").
- Baseline (doc_service_late_payment_charge_amount_method): unpaid portion = min(bill 168.51, outstanding balance 499.62 [or 357.12 after the outage credit]) = 168.51; rate × unpaid rounded; minimum RS 1.00.
- Repeat-lateness rate factor (doc_service_repeat_lateness_late_charge_rate) with its window from doc_service_autopay_repeat_lateness_window: autopay payments in the 12 months before 2026-09-29 = 2025-12-22, 2026-01-23, 2026-02-23 → 3 → window = 3 calendar months; LPCs dated less than 3 whole months before 9/29 (after 2026-06-29): 2026-07-28, 2026-08-30 → 2 → 1.25 × 1.5% = 1.875%. 168.51 × 0.01875 = 3.1595625 → 3.16.
  - Interpretive point recorded: the 2026-02-23 autopay payment was later reversed as returned (reversal 2026-02-26). I count it as an autopay payment "received" (the payment row stands; the reversal is a separate charge row). If it were excluded the count would be 2 → 12-month window → 5 LPCs → 1.5× rate → different figure (3.40). No visible sentence states whether a reversed autopay payment is still counted.
- Energy-assistance hardship share (doc_service_energy_assistance_late_charge_share): agency payments in 12 months before the charge: 2025-11-07 (200.00) and 2026-07-15 (90.00) → 2 → 0.5: 3.16 × 0.5 = 1.58; minimum 1.00 applied → 1.58.
- Notice surcharge (doc_service_written_notice_late_charge_surcharge): written notices in 12 months before the charge: 2025-10-27, 2026-09-14 → 2 → +1.50 → **3.08**.
- Fall-back (baseline only): 168.51 × 1.5% = 2.52765 → **2.53**.

**(b) Sustained-outage credit on outage 53768c09** (posting 2026-09-29; schedule RS in effect on outage start).
- Baseline (doc_service_sustained_credit_amount_method): qualifying = recorded 29.6 h; min 24; excess 5.6; increment hours 12 → 0 increments; base 35.00; cap 135.00 → fall-back **35.00**.
- Meter-interval factor (doc_service_outage_duration_meter_interval_measure; Metering Service catalogue reached by KB grep on the record's own meter type "Standard AMI Smart Meter": interval data "60 minutes") → qualifying duration 30 h.
- Minimum-duration factor (doc_service_outage_credit_minimum_duration_energy_assistance): 2 agency payments in 12 months → 0.5 × 24 = 12 h. Excess = 18 h.
- Increment-hours factor (doc_service_outage_credit_increment_hours_repeated_outages): records at the address begun in 12 months before 9/29: 2025-12-03, 2026-03-18, 2026-06-21, 2026-09-08 → 4 → 0.5 × 12 = 6 h → floor(18/6) = 3 increments.
- Base-by-cause factor (doc_service_outage_credit_base_amount_by_cause): equipment failure → 1.5 × 35.00 = 52.50.
- Increment-amount factor (doc_service_outage_credit_increment_amount_equipment_failures): equipment-failure records in 12 months: 2026-03-18, 2026-09-08 → 2 → 1.2 × 25.00 = 30.00.
- Cap factor (doc_service_outage_credit_cap_length_of_service): start 2016-05-02 → 124 whole months → 1.3 × 135.00 = 175.50.
- Credit = min(52.50 + 3 × 30.00, 175.50) = **142.50**.

**(c) Reconnection payment amount** (payment day 2026-09-29, after (a) and (b) are on the account; balance 499.62 + 3.08 − 142.50 = 360.20).
- Baseline (doc_service_reconnection_payment_amount_worked_examples): balance less every LPC ever posted, rounded, floor 0. Fall-back on the same post-write account: 360.20 − 15.47 = **344.73** (on the untouched account: 499.62 − 12.39 = 487.23).
- Basis-by-reconnection-history factor (doc_service_reconnection_payment_basis_by_reconnection_history): reconnection charges in 24 months: 2025-11-07 → exactly 1 → basis = balance less LPCs posted 12 or more months before the payment: only the 2025-09-29 LPC (2.72; exactly 12 whole months, "not dated less than 12 whole calendar months") → 360.20 − 2.72 = 357.48.
- Energy-assistance share (doc_service_reconnection_payment_energy_assistance_share): 2 agency payments in 12 months → 0.6.
- Tenure share (doc_service_reconnection_payment_tenure_share_card): 124 months → 0.9. 357.48 × 0.6 × 0.9 = 193.0392 → 193.04.
- Good-faith add-on (doc_service_reconnection_good_faith_add_on_training): written notices in 12 months: 2 → 0.5 × RS notice minimum 100.00 = 50.00.
- Returned-payment add-on (doc_service_reconnection_returned_payment_add_on_terms): reversals in 12 months: 2026-02-26 → 1 → 2.5 × RS fee 20.00 = 50.00.
- Amount = 193.04 + 50.00 + 50.00 = **293.04** (card payment by the customer for exactly this).

**(d) Reconnection charge on the order** (order date 2026-09-29).
- Baseline (doc_service_reconnection_charge_amount_field_services): RS field standard-hours 65.00 → fall-back **65.00**.

  - "The reconnection payment amount is fixed only after the agreement carries a late payment charge on its most recent bill once that bill's grace period has ended with part of it unpaid." Records: most recent bill 99539ce4 due 9/22, grace ended 9/27, balance 499.62 → part unpaid; no LPC on it → state does not hold. Searched with the sentence's words "late payment charge … most recent bill … grace period" → doc_service_late_payment_charge_posting_tool_card ("A late payment charge is posted on the most recent bill of the agreement once that bill's grace period has ended with part of the bill unpaid…"; its own tool). **Hop P1: state-derived.**
  - "The reconnection payment amount is not fixed until the agreement carries the sustained-outage credit owed for the most recent outage record at its service address when that record qualifies." Records: outage 53768c09, 29.6 h equipment failure, qualifies (≥ 12 h reduced minimum; ≥ 24 h even at baseline); no credit → state does not hold. Searched "sustained-outage credit … most recent outage record … qualifies" → doc_service_sustained_credit_posting_tool_card ("posted … without waiting for the customer to ask, for the most recent outage record at its service address once that record qualifies"). **Hop P2: state-derived.**

- Order: {post LPC, post sustained-outage credit} (either order) → card payment of the amount → reconnection order. Direction: reconnection order ← card payment ← (LPC, sustained-outage credit).

The record-terms restatement ("In terms of the agreement's records: while … the agreement carries no late payment charge on that bill, the reconnection payment amount is not yet fixed …") stays in state form.

### Two-way counter-proof
- Supports: every figure above is derived from quoted docs and finder returns; the replay of the four writes succeeded and reached "active".
- Closest alternatives excluded:
  - Reconnection payment = past-due balance (doc_service_reconnection_charge_schedule_values row "Reconnection payment basis | past-due balance" for RS) — excluded by doc_service_reconnection_requirements: "The clause under which the payment requirement was met when payments … reached the schedule's reconnection payment basis measured at disconnection (the past-due balance for residential schedules …) is no longer in force". Residual friction noted: the schedule-values doc still explains the row as "the amount that must be paid before a disconnected account is reconnected" without marking it retired.
  - Reconnection charge 65.00 by "elected after-hours / field" — excluded: the remote path applies (Standard AMI meter remote-capable, no confirmed finding), the old charge-by-method clause is retired in doc_service_reconnection_requirements.
  - LPC unpaid portion = bill less payments applied by the grace end — retired clause (doc_service_late_payment_charge_terms §4); current basis = min(bill, balance).
  - Sustained-outage credit only on request / within the claim window — on-request term retired (doc_service_sustained_outage_credit_terms "Terms no longer in force"); posting card says "without waiting for the customer to ask".
  - LPC 2025-09-29 in the reconnection basis: exactly 12 whole months → "not dated less than 12 whole calendar months" → in the subtracted set.
- "Do only the one thing asked" (card payment of the untouched balance-less-LPC figure, then reconnect) is excluded: the card-payment doc's own sentences say the amount is not fixed while the most recent bill (grace ended, part unpaid) carries no LPC and while the qualifying latest outage carries no sustained-outage credit; the records show both states unmet.
- Fall-back numbers (computation documents only): LPC 2.53; sustained-outage credit 35.00; reconnection payment 344.73 (post-write) / 487.23 (untouched); reconnection charge 65.00 — all definite and all differ from my answers (3.08 / 142.50 / 293.04 / 8.85).
